---
title: inif.tagging
description: Type aliases and modes for the tagging methods on Sample / InifDocument.
reference: inif.tagging
---

Tagging is exposed as methods on [`Sample`](inif.models.qmd) and
[`InifDocument`](inif.models.qmd) — `tag_by_regex`, `tag_by_regexes`,
`tag_by_text_regex`, `tag_by_predicate`, `tag_by_predicates`,
`tag_chat_roles`, `tag_special_tokens`, `create_span_from_tag`. This
module re-exports the supporting types so callers building up batched
tagger lists can spell them out.

See [Tagging tokens](../workflows/tagging.qmd) for usage patterns and the
difference between token-string and concatenated-text matching.

### TextTagMode
